facts.content: Patient has a 3-day history of mainly watery diarrhea.
Patient reports no blood in the stool and is opening bowels 6 times a day.
facts.source_text: No blood in stool. Opening bowels x6/day.

facts.content: There is associated intermittent, crampy pain in the left lower quadrant (LLQ) with no radiation.
facts.source_text: Associated LLQ pain - crampy, intermittent, nil radiation.

facts.content: Patient is also vomiting, which is mainly bilious, with no blood present.
facts.source_text: Also vomiting - mainly bilous. No blood in vomit.

facts.content: Patient had a fever on the first day which has since resolved, but has been feeling lethargic and weak.
facts.source_text: Fever on first day, nil since. Has been feeling lethargic and weak since.

facts.content: Patient ate a takeaway from a Chinese restaurant 4 days ago.
Patient's wife and children are also unwell with vomiting but not diarrhea.
facts.source_text: Wife and children also unwell with vomiting, but no diarrhea.

facts.content: Patient reports no other unwell contacts.
Patient has a history of Asthma.
Patient works as an accountant and lives with his wife and children.
facts.source_text: SH: works as an accountant. Lives with wife and children.

facts.content: The symptoms are affecting his Activities of Daily Living (ADLs).
facts.source_text: Affecting his ADLs as has to be near toilet often.

facts.content: Patient has no history of smoking or alcohol use.
Advised conservative management including rest, increased fluid intake, and paracetamol if feverish.
facts.source_text: Conservative management - rest, push fluids, paracetamol if feverish.

facts.content: Patient to have a review in 3-5 days if symptoms do not improve.
facts.source_text: To review in 3-5d if symptoms not improving.

facts.content: Advised to seek review earlier if feeling more unwell.
facts.source_text: To see earlier if feeling more unwell.
